name: std-learn-stepper
description: Generic staged-sequence instrument — the learner moves a Next/Prev cursor across an ordered roster of stages laid out as a timeline: a legend names each category color, the cursor stage rings and grows while past/future stages stay visually distinct by reveal state, the current stage label and description render prominently in a card, a per-category running tally updates live, progress reads stage k of n, and the Prev/Next cursor clamps deliberately at either end with a narrated note rather than silently doing nothing. The category-lens filter dims non-matching stages instead of hiding them, keeping the whole timeline in view. Stage and category vocabulary is entirely config-declared, so the same mechanism serves any ordered-sequence domain (periodization timelines, phase cycles, stellar evolution, and beyond) on a math-canvas. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.

schema.description: Generic staged-sequence instrument — the learner moves a Next/Prev cursor across an ordered roster of stages laid out as a timeline: a legend names each category color, the cursor stage rings and grows while past/future stages stay visually distinct by reveal state, the current stage label and description render prominently in a card, a per-category running tally updates live, progress reads stage k of n, and the Prev/Next cursor clamps deliberately at either end with a narrated note rather than silently doing nothing. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.
schema.name: std-learn-stepper

allSummary.default: Taken together, every stage contributes to the full sequence. No single category tells the whole story.
allSummary.description: Narrative summary shown when no category filter is applied — the full, multi-category picture.
allSummary.label: All-Lens Summary
allSummary.synonyms: multi-causal, full picture, no single lens

atEndNote.default: — Last stage; press Reset to review from the start.
atEndNote.description: Text appended to the current stage's description once the cursor reaches the final stage, narrating that Next is now deliberately clamped rather than doing nothing.
atEndNote.label: At-End Note

axisY.description: Canvas y-position of the horizontal axis.
axisY.label: Axis Y

categories.description: Marker color and button label per stage category, used for the axis dots, the legend, the FILTER_CATEGORY buttons, and the running per-category tally.
categories.label: Categories
categories.synonyms: category color, category legend, stage category, filter lens

default.summary: Viewed through Category A alone, only the stages tagged A are highlighted.
Viewed through Category B alone, only the stages tagged B are highlighted.

categorySummaries.description: Narrative summary shown when the learner filters the sequence to a single category — how the sequence reads through that lens alone.
categorySummaries.label: Category Summaries
categorySummaries.synonyms: historiographical lens, primary source lens, single-cause narrative, category narrative, visible thread

interactive.description: Enable pointer interaction on the canvas.
interactive.label: Interactive

markerHighlightRadius.description: Radius of the current step's marker, larger than an ordinary stage marker.
markerHighlightRadius.label: Marker Highlight Radius

matchMode.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.
matchMode.label: Match Mode

maxPosition.description: Latest position on the axis (after the last stage).
maxPosition.label: Max Position

minPosition.description: Earliest position on the axis (before the first stage).
minPosition.label: Min Position

stages.description: Ordered roster of stages (position, label, category, description) stepped through by NEXT/PREV and filtered by FILTER_CATEGORY. Sorted ascending by position.
stages.label: Stages
stages.synonyms: stage roster, sequence, timeline, cycle, phase, event roster, ordered stages

startPrompt.description: Narration shown before the learner has advanced past the first stage.
startPrompt.label: Start Prompt

unreachedColor.description: Color of stage markers the learner has not yet stepped to.
unreachedColor.label: Unreached Marker Color

emits.description: The cursor/filter state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
emits.synonyms: stepper update, cursor advance, stage reveal, timeline step

events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.
events.name: Mode Selected

events.description: Learner advanced the cursor to the next stage in the ordered roster; clamps at the last stage with a narrated end note rather than wrapping.
events.name: Next

events.description: Learner moved the cursor back to the previous stage in the ordered roster; clamps before the first stage, reverting to the start prompt.
events.name: Prev

events.description: Learner picked a category lens (or all) — non-matching stage markers on the timeline dim rather than disappear, keeping the whole sequence in view.
events.name: Filter Category

events.description: Learner reset the cursor to before the first stage and cleared the category filter.
events.name: Reset Stepper

events.description: The cursor/filter state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.name: Stepper Advanced
events.synonyms: stepper update, cursor advance, stage reveal, timeline step

app std-learn-stepper "1.0.0"
"Generic staged-sequence instrument — the learner moves a Next/Prev cursor across an ordered roster of stages laid out as a timeline: a legend names each category color, the cursor stage rings and grows while past/future stages stay visually distinct by reveal state, the current stage label and description render prominently in a card, a per-category running tally updates live, progress reads stage k of n, and the Prev/Next cursor clamps deliberately at either end with a narrated note rather than silently doing nothing. The category-lens filter dims non-matching stages instead of hiding them, keeping the whole timeline in view. Stage and category vocabulary is entirely config-declared, so the same mechanism serves any ordered-sequence domain (periodization timelines, phase cycles, stellar evolution, and beyond) on a math-canvas. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches."
orbital LearnStepperOrbital {
  type LearnStepperShapePoint = {
    x : number!
    y : number!
  }
  type LearnStepperShape = {
    type : "line" | "arrow" | "circle" | "rect" | "polygon" | "path" | "text" | "axis" | "grid"!
    id : string
    x : number
    y : number
    x1 : number
    y1 : number
    x2 : number
    y2 : number
    radius : number
    width : number
    height : number
    points : [LearnStepperShapePoint]
    path : string
    text : string
    label : string
    fontSize : number
    align : "left" | "center" | "right"
    axis : "x" | "y"
    min : number
    max : number
    step : number
    color : string
    fill : string
    lineWidth : number
    opacity : number
  }
  type LearnStepperStage = {
    id : string!
    position : number!
    label : string!
    category : string!
    description : string
  }
  type LearnStepperCategory = {
    category : string!
    color : string!
    label : string
  }
  type LearnStepperCategorySummary = {
    category : string!
    summary : string!
  }
  type LearnStepperTallyItem = {
    label : string!
    count : number!
  }

  entity LearnStepperScene [runtime] {
    id : string!
    active : boolean = false
    title : string
    cursorIndex : number
    activeFilter : string
    narration : string
    currentStageLabel : string
    currentStageDescription : string
    categoryTally : string
    tallyItems : [LearnStepperTallyItem]
    visibleThreadNote : string
    shapes : [LearnStepperShape]
    filterButtons : [node]
  }

  trait LearnStepperSim -> @rebindable LearnStepperScene [interaction, instance] {
    initial: idle

    state idle {
      INIT -> idle when (== @config.matchMode "")
        (set @entity.active true)
        (set @entity.title @config.title)
        (set @entity.cursorIndex -1)
        (set @entity.activeFilter "all")
        (let (
            (currentPosition (if (>= @entity.cursorIndex 0) (object/get (array/nth @config.stages @entity.cursorIndex) position) (- @config.minPosition 1)))
            (currentStage (if (>= @entity.cursorIndex 0) (array/nth @config.stages @entity.cursorIndex) null))
            (totalStages (array/len @config.stages))
            (atEnd (and (>= @entity.cursorIndex 0) (>= @entity.cursorIndex (- @totalStages 1))))
            (stageLabel (if (!= @currentStage null) (object/get @currentStage label) ""))
            (stageDescription (if (!= @currentStage null) (object/get @currentStage description) @config.startPrompt))
            (boundedDescription (if @atEnd (str/concat @stageDescription @config.atEndNote) @stageDescription))
            (narration (if (!= @currentStage null) (str/concat (str/concat "" (object/get @currentStage position)) " — " @stageLabel ". " @boundedDescription) @config.startPrompt))
            (tallyParts (array/map @config.categories (fn cc (str/concat (object/get @cc label) ": " (array/len (array/filter @config.stages (fn s (and (<= @s.position @currentPosition) (== @s.category (object/get @cc category))))))))))
            (categoryTally (str/join @tallyParts " · "))
            (tallyItems (array/map @config.categories (fn cc { label: (object/get @cc label), count: (array/len (array/filter @config.stages (fn s (and (<= @s.position @currentPosition) (== @s.category (object/get @cc category)))))) })))
            (visibleThreadNote (if (== @entity.activeFilter "all") @config.allSummary (object/get (array/first (array/filter @config.categorySummaries (fn cs (== @cs.category @entity.activeFilter)))) summary)))
            (axisWidth (- @config.width (+ @config.axisMarginLeft @config.axisMarginRight)))
            (baseShapes [
              { type: line, id: "axis", x1: @config.axisMarginLeft, y1: @config.axisY, x2: (- @config.width @config.axisMarginRight), y2: @config.axisY, color: "#78716c", lineWidth: 2, opacity: 1 },
              { type: text, id: "minPositionLabel", x: @config.axisMarginLeft, y: (+ @config.axisY 26), text: (str/concat "" @config.minPosition), fontSize: 11, align: "left", color: "#78716c" },
              { type: text, id: "maxPositionLabel", x: (- @config.width @config.axisMarginRight), y: (+ @config.axisY 26), text: (str/concat "" @config.maxPosition), fontSize: 11, align: "right", color: "#78716c" }
            ])
            (markerShapes (array/flatten (array/map @config.stages (fn s (let (
                (isRevealed (<= @s.position @currentPosition))
                (isCurrent (== @s.position @currentPosition))
                (matchesFilter (or (== @entity.activeFilter "all") (== @s.category @entity.activeFilter)))
                (catColorObj (array/first (array/filter @config.categories (fn cc (== @cc.category @s.category)))))
                (catColor (object/get @catColorObj color))
                (col (if @isRevealed @catColor @config.unreachedColor))
                (baseOpacity (if @isRevealed 0.9 0.35))
                (finalOpacity (if @matchesFilter @baseOpacity (* @baseOpacity 0.25)))
                (xPos (+ @config.axisMarginLeft (* (/ (- @s.position @config.minPosition) (- @config.maxPosition @config.minPosition)) @axisWidth)))
                (rad (if @isCurrent @config.markerHighlightRadius @config.markerRadius))
              )
              (if @isCurrent
                [
                  { type: circle, id: (str/concat "ring-" @s.position), x: @xPos, y: @config.axisY, radius: (+ @rad 5), color: @catColor, fill: "transparent", lineWidth: 3, opacity: 1 },
                  { type: circle, id: (str/concat "marker-" @s.position), x: @xPos, y: @config.axisY, radius: @rad, color: @col, fill: @col, opacity: @finalOpacity }
                ]
                [
                  { type: circle, id: (str/concat "marker-" @s.position), x: @xPos, y: @config.axisY, radius: @rad, color: @col, fill: @col, opacity: @finalOpacity }
                ]
              )
            )))))

            (filterButtons (array/concat [

          )

            (set @entity.narration @narration)
            (set @entity.currentStageLabel @stageLabel)
            (set @entity.currentStageDescription @boundedDescription)
            (set @entity.categoryTally @categoryTally)
            (set @entity.tallyItems @tallyItems)
            (set @entity.visibleThreadNote @visibleThreadNote)
            (set @entity.shapes @allShapes)
            (set @entity.filterButtons @filterButtons)
          )
        )
        (render-ui main {
          type: box
          padding: md
          children: [
            { type: stack, direction: vertical, gap: md, children: [
                { type: typography, variant: h4, content: @entity.title },

                { type: chart-legend, items: (array/map @config.categories (fn cc { label: (object/get @cc label), color: (object/get @cc color) })), direction: horizontal },
                { type: math-canvas, width: @config.width, height: @config.height, xMin: 0, xMax: @config.width, yMin: 0, yMax: @config.height, showAxes: false, showGrid: false, gridStep: 1, curves: [], points: [], vectors: [], shapes: @entity.shapes, interactive: @config.interactive, animate: @config.animate },
                { type: stack, direction: horizontal, gap: xs, children: @entity.filterButtons },
                { type: stack, direction: horizontal, gap: sm, children: [
                    { type: button, action: PREV, label: "Prev", variant: ghost, disabled: (if (<= @entity.cursorIndex -1) true false) },
                    { type: button, action: NEXT, label: "Next", variant: primary, disabled: (if (>= @entity.cursorIndex (- (array/len @config.stages) 1)) true false) },
                    { type: button, action: RESET_STEPPER, label: "Reset", variant: ghost }
                  ] },
                { type: card, variant: bordered, padding: md, title: (if (!= @entity.currentStageLabel "") @entity.currentStageLabel "Not Started"), children: [
                    { type: typography, variant: body, content: @entity.currentStageDescription }
                  ] },
                { type: stack, direction: horizontal, gap: xs, children: (array/map @entity.tallyItems (fn t { type: badge, variant: neutral, label: (str/concat (object/get @t label) ": " (str/concat "" (object/get @t count))) })) },
                { type: typography, variant: caption, content: @entity.visibleThreadNote }

      MODE_SELECTED -> idle when (== ?mode @config.matchMode)

                { type: stack, direction: horizontal, gap: xs, children: (array/map @entity.tallyItems (fn t { type: badge, variant: neutral, label: (str/concat (object/get @t label) ": " (str/concat "" (object/get @t count))) })) },
                { type: typography, variant: caption, content: @entity.visibleThreadNote }
              ] }
          ]
        })
        (emit STEPPER_ADVANCED { cursorIndex: @entity.cursorIndex, activeFilter: @entity.activeFilter, currentLabel: @entity.narration })

    }

    listens {
      MODE_SELECTED {
        mode : string
      }
        @description "Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null."
        @tier "domain"
      NEXT {
      }
        @description "Learner advanced the cursor to the next stage in the ordered roster; clamps at the last stage with a narrated end note rather than wrapping."
        @tier "domain"
      PREV {
      }
        @description "Learner moved the cursor back to the previous stage in the ordered roster; clamps before the first stage, reverting to the start prompt."
        @tier "domain"
      FILTER_CATEGORY {
        category : string
      }
        @description "Learner picked a category lens (or all) — non-matching stage markers on the timeline dim rather than disappear, keeping the whole sequence in view."
        @tier "domain"
      RESET_STEPPER {
      }
        @description "Learner reset the cursor to before the first stage and cleared the category filter."
        @tier "domain"
    }

    emits {
      STEPPER_ADVANCED -> external {
        cursorIndex : number
        activeFilter : string
        currentLabel : string
      }
        @description "The cursor/filter state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone."
        @synonyms "stepper update, cursor advance, stage reveal, timeline step"
        @tier "domain"
    }

    config {
      matchMode : string = ""
        @label "Match Mode"
        @description "When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT."
        @tier "presentation"
      title : string = "Stepper"
        @label "Title"
        @description "Title shown above the instrument."
        @tier "presentation"
      width : number = 640
        @label "Width"
        @description "Canvas width in pixels."
        @tier "presentation"
      height : number = 420
        @label "Height"
        @description "Canvas height in pixels."
        @tier "presentation"
      backgroundColor : string = "#f8fafc"
        @label "Background Color"
        @tier "presentation"
      interactive : boolean = false
        @label "Interactive"
        @description "Enable pointer interaction on the canvas."
        @tier "presentation"
      animate : boolean = false
        @label "Animate"
        @description "Enable continuous redraw loop."
        @tier "presentation"
      stages : [LearnStepperStage] = [
        { id: "stage-1", position: 1, label: "Stage One", category: "a", description: "First stage in the sequence." },
        { id: "stage-2", position: 2, label: "Stage Two", category: "b", description: "Second stage in the sequence." },
        { id: "stage-3", position: 3, label: "Stage Three", category: "a", description: "Third stage in the sequence." }
      ]
        @label "Stages"
        @description "Ordered roster of stages (position, label, category, description) stepped through by NEXT/PREV and filtered by FILTER_CATEGORY. Sorted ascending by position."
        @synonyms "stage roster, sequence, timeline, cycle, phase, event roster, ordered stages"
        @tier "domain"
      categories : [LearnStepperCategory] = [
        { category: "a", color: "#7c3aed", label: "Category A" },
        { category: "b", color: "#15803d", label: "Category B" }
      ]
        @label "Categories"
        @description "Marker color and button label per stage category, used for the axis dots, the legend, the FILTER_CATEGORY buttons, and the running per-category tally."
        @synonyms "category color, category legend, stage category, filter lens"
        @tier "domain"
      categorySummaries : [LearnStepperCategorySummary] = [
        { category: "a", summary: "Viewed through Category A alone, only the stages tagged A are highlighted." },
        { category: "b", summary: "Viewed through Category B alone, only the stages tagged B are highlighted." }
      ]
        @label "Category Summaries"
        @description "Narrative summary shown when the learner filters the sequence to a single category — how the sequence reads through that lens alone."
        @synonyms "historiographical lens, primary source lens, single-cause narrative, category narrative, visible thread"
        @tier "domain"
      allSummary : string = "Taken together, every stage contributes to the full sequence. No single category tells the whole story."
        @label "All-Lens Summary"
        @description "Narrative summary shown when no category filter is applied — the full, multi-category picture."
        @synonyms "multi-causal, full picture, no single lens"
        @tier "domain"
      allLabel : string = "All"
        @label "All Filter Label"
        @tier "presentation"
      startPrompt : string = "Press Next to begin."
        @label "Start Prompt"
        @description "Narration shown before the learner has advanced past the first stage."
        @tier "presentation"
      atEndNote : string = " — Last stage; press Reset to review from the start."
        @label "At-End Note"
        @description "Text appended to the current stage's description once the cursor reaches the final stage, narrating that Next is now deliberately clamped rather than doing nothing."
        @tier "presentation"
      minPosition : number = 0
        @label "Min Position"
        @description "Earliest position on the axis (before the first stage)."
        @tier "domain"
      maxPosition : number = 4
        @label "Max Position"
        @description "Latest position on the axis (after the last stage)."
        @tier "domain"
      axisY : number = 220
        @label "Axis Y"
        @description "Canvas y-position of the horizontal axis."
        @tier "presentation"
      axisMarginLeft : number = 60
        @label "Axis Left Margin"
        @tier "presentation"
      axisMarginRight : number = 60
        @label "Axis Right Margin"
        @tier "presentation"
      markerRadius : number = 8
        @label "Marker Radius"
        @tier "presentation"
      markerHighlightRadius : number = 14
        @label "Marker Highlight Radius"
        @description "Radius of the current step's marker, larger than an ordinary stage marker."
        @tier "presentation"
      unreachedColor : string = "#d6d3d1"
        @label "Unreached Marker Color"
        @description "Color of stage markers the learner has not yet stepped to."
        @tier "presentation"
    }
  }

  page "/learn-stepper" as LearnStepperPage -> LearnStepperSim
}
